title: Ornith MLX-4bit vs GGUF-Q6_K deterministic quality/performance A/B

mlx4.note: The first model response hit its output cap after initial tools, but the agent recovered, reread the output, and finished normally.

q6.note: The first run created the correct output and reread it, but the outer foreground wrapper interrupted before final response. A background retry stalled at initialization while the Q6 64K server reached 8% free memory; it was stopped for host safety. EXP-019 remains the valid prior Q6 native-tool reference (cold 78.5 s, warm 4.7 s, real executor completion).

resource_notes.q6: Direct-suite resource telemetry began at only 15% free memory and ended at 7%, with swap/pageout growth. It is recorded but not used as an arm-to-arm resource comparison.
resource_notes.mlx4: Direct suite began at 70% free and ended at 36%; swapouts did not increase in that arm. Conditions were not matched, so this is not a promotion performance claim.
